metadata.geometry: Union of nondegenerate XY source mesh triangles; concavity, holes and boundary contacts retained. Building objects are not legal parcels.
metadata.heightReference: Per-object original model minimum Z; approximate source/SRTM placement, not official building grades or sea-level entitlement.
metadata.planeCertainty: No official lower surfaces are embedded. Compatible runtime study coefficients are required; a default invented plane remains Study.

zoningStatus.0: Sourced selected-use basic reference over the whole footprint

metadata.storage: Project asset plus bounded runtime RAM; no browser persistent storage.
metadata.coverage: 61,407 existing context objects within the loaded model, not every Vancouver parcel or an entitlement model.
limitations: Partial schedule coverage: unknown zones, DD and site-specific CD-1 have no numeric reference; no default citywide cap.
Numeric references are selected basic schedule values for the described use, not exact permitted maximums or approved development rights.
Building-use, tenure, affordability, frontage, minimum site area, setbacks, sloping envelopes, view protection, heritage, flood and discretionary conditions are not resolved.
Zoning building height generally uses official building grades / a defined base surface, not model terrain or sea level; model z datum is unknown.
Assessment parcels and zoning are approximate dated snapshots, not surveyed legal site boundaries or ownership/vacancy evidence.
No geometry is clipped to context-model coverage; parcels beyond available terrain need appropriate visual treatment.
Building By-law construction requirements are separate from these Zoning and Development By-law references.
